title: ABS Slicing in PrusaSlicer and Web Upload
description: Setting up the GTMAX Core H5 ABS profile in PrusaSlicer, anti-warping parameters, and direct G-code upload via web browser.
objectives: Import and position .STL models in PrusaSlicer
Configure thermal settings for ABS (Nozzle: 240°C, Bed: 100°C, Fan: 0%)
Enable Brim to improve first-layer adhesion
Slice the model and upload the .gcode file using your browser

materials.name: Computer with PrusaSlicer installed
materials.notes: On the same local network as the printer

steps.title: Importing and ABS Configuration in PrusaSlicer
steps.description: Profile selection and fan cooling disabled.
details: Select the GTMAX Core H5 printer profile and Generic ABS filament
Import the .STL model and lay its largest flat face onto the bed
In 'Filament Settings', ensure Print Cooling Fan is set to 0%
In 'Skirt and Brim', enable Outer Brim with a width of 8mm

steps.title: Slicing and Layer Preview
details: Click 'Slice Now' and inspect print layers in 3D preview
Verify Brim fusion lines and total estimated print time
Export and save the .gcode file to your computer

steps.title: Browser Web Upload
steps.description: Sending the file directly via printer website.
details: Open the GTMAX web page in your browser
Click the 'Upload' button and select your saved .gcode file
Confirm the file appears in the printer library

troubleshooting.problem: G-code file fails to upload on printer website
solutions: Refresh browser page and reconnect to the web interface
